body:
Who Exclusive is for

Exclusive is for buyers of luxury property: seafront villas, estates, large plots by the sea and special properties from €1 million upwards. It is not a general newsletter. If your budget is lower, our member account already shows you more than a guest sees, and our listings cover every price range.

What Exclusive members see

Guests on our site see the municipality of a property and its public photos. Members see more. Exclusive members see everything we know about the property:

  • the exact location of the property
  • the price history
  • videos, documents and floor plans
  • early access: new properties and price drops reach you before they reach the market, with a notification on your phone

The Secret Portfolio: properties that are never advertised

Some owners of high-value homes do not want their property on any portal. We keep these properties in our Secret Portfolio, which only Exclusive members can see. Many of the most interesting properties in Halkidiki change hands this way, without ever being advertised.

Your own agent

Your time is the most valuable thing, and we respect that. Your agent knows what you are looking for, answers you first and takes you through the whole purchase, from the first viewing to the contract.

How to join

  • Create a member account on our site, if you do not have one yet.
  • Press «Join Exclusive» in your account.
  • Our team reviews your request and may contact you briefly to understand what you are looking for.
  • We open your access once the request is approved, and introduce you to your agent.

Discretion

Your search, your budget and the properties you look at stay between you and our team. Your personal details and requests are stored encrypted, and no other agent or company can see them. The same applies to the owners: details of the Secret Portfolio are shared only with approved members.
